title: Young Pros Roundtable (45 and younger)
seo_title: Young Pros Roundtable (45 & Under) in Republic, MO
description: The Young Pros Roundtable for professionals 45 and younger takes place on Monday, November 9, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. It is held at Black Lab Coffee Company, 545 E Elm St in Republic, MO. The event is hosted by the Republic Area Chamber of Commerce and focuses on professional development and social networking.
